text:
Sam Bennett started slowly for a player coming off a Conn Smythe and back-to-back Cups, and the headlines this week caught the turn: four goals in his last four games, including two in the 4-1 win at Columbus on November 10. Seven goals in 20 games now, right about where his chances say (5.8 expected goals).

The assists are the odd part. He has three all season and none in his last ten. Florida has scored 4.9 fewer goals than the chances deserve with him on the ice, which has cost him points and usually evens out.

Evolving-Hockey's read from last season is the honest caveat: he faces top competition (90th percentile), but chances against rise with him out there and he takes more penalties than he draws. That's the Bennett trade-off the Panthers have always accepted. His skating distance ranks in the 93rd percentile by NHL Edge. He covers the ice. When his linemates start finishing, the point totals will look like his usual seasons.
headline: Bennett has found the net again
